body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and Suburban Directory for 1876.
A copy of the full directory is held by Melbourne History Resources, and you can read it online.

The 1876 directory has its own Carlton section, under North Melbourne (pp. 61–77), covering the area east of the Elizabeth-street extension between Victoria-street east and Park-street, as far east as Nicholson-street, including the streets it marks "N Carlton". It lists the streets alphabetically, four columns to a page, each house by house with the cross streets in order. All of the section is included here. Rathdowne, Berkeley, Neild and McArthur are stored as Rathdown, Berkley, Neill and Macarthur to match the later years.
